answer: Hard verdicts travel by whisper, not shout: a random secret quorum receives each claim privately and returns sealed verdicts - no public roll-call to bribe, no queue to buy into. Then the gale comes: every few epochs sealed verdicts are unsealed and cross-checked against what re-execution showed, and whisperers whose verdicts diverged lose the right. A deal cut in the dark is published in the storm. Accounts that are hollow trunks - much claimed, nothing audible inside - sound wrong when the quorum knocks, and the storm proves the whisper right. Honest agents whisper what they shout.
